epic.title: Epic 568 wave 1 recut - engine-native isolation against a stored spine origin
epic.intent_and_why: Engine state must carry who it belongs to. This issue is the same defect one layer over: state that does not know where it lives. A spine carries its own repo reference from creation and the engine enforces worktree isolation natively against it, instead of delegating that judgment to a subprocess check wired into one template.

definition_of_done: A spine stamped with origin at creation.
The engine refuses guarded verbs driven from outside that origin, natively, without forwarding a cwd.
The superseded template check and its coverage apparatus are gone.
A test exercises a spine that actually carries origin, on both the match and the mismatch side.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Every new check demonstrated failing in the defective world and passing in the healthy one.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Full suite with no new failures against main's baseline, plus an arming repro decided on state facts rather than refusal prose.
good_enough.appetite: One Commander, serialized lane, no concurrent dispatch on the engine-core files.

hard_constraints: Engine-native comparison; never forward a cwd to a subprocess check.
The stamp and the native check land as ONE change; the read side alone is inert.
The resolved root is a parameter distinct from base_dir.
scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and scripts/agent_work_root.py must not be edited.

current_wave.objective: Land the stored spine origin and the engine-native isolation guard as one change, with coverage that can actually fail.
exit_criteria: Full suite passes with no new failures against main's Linux baseline of 2934 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed.
The before/after repro arms the gate on state facts.
tests/test_spine_origin_isolation.py covers a spine carrying origin on both sides.

issues.title: Stored spine origin plus engine-native worktree isolation
issues.desired_outcome: The engine enforces worktree isolation for every spine on every guarded verb, against a value the spine cannot edit.
issues.useful_now: It is the substrate the rest of the epic 568 tranche reads from.
issues.appetite: One gate, three halves plus docs.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The native refusal fires in the case init.c0 used to catch, and leaves no lease on the spine.
issues.implementation_latitude: How the root is threaded, where the comparison sits, which verbs are guarded, whether the live origin-less spines are backfilled.
hard_constraints_no_gos: No write on the refusal path.
No edit to spine_rail.py or agent_work_root.py.
local_unknowns: Whether the guard breaks the in-process MCP caller at scripts/mcp_spine_server.py:361.

wave_forecast.outcome: Extend the origin stamp to the other spine instantiation paths, so child checklists carry it too.
wave_forecast.why_likely: The stamp lands only in init_work_area and spine_lifecycle; child checklists such as review.json and IMPLEMENTER_PLAN.json are created elsewhere and stay unguarded.

wave_forecast.outcome: Close the claim --force gap for a spine whose worktree was removed at closeout.
wave_forecast.why_likely: release is exempt so lease clearing survives, but claim --force against a removed worktree is refused with no hatch.

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether guarding claim and heartbeat breaks a real cross-tree workflow.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: The full suite plus the in-process MCP shape test.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: current stays exempt, which is the read path the MCP door is most used for.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Watch for refusals in live runs after merge.

parked_possibilities: Guarding current as well, which both plan candidates rejected because it would break the cross-tree REFRESH REQUESTED read.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Stored spine origin and engine-native worktree isolation landed with both human-ruled caller repairs: CLI crews run from an absolute assigned worktree and the in-process MCP door stands in its bound spine worktree for each engine call.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Fresh independent re-review APPROVE; native repro GATE ARMED; engine-owned integration suite passed 2981 tests with 6 skipped after the Admiral-ratified clean-child check correction; execute.json terminal.

wave_evidence.claim: The native refusal fires where init.c0 used to catch, and takes no lease.
wave_evidence.expected: origin spine driven from the main checkout is REFUSED and writes nothing.
wave_evidence.observed: REFUSED; spine byte-identical and mtime-identical; no journal sidecar. Decided on the state fact, not on the refusal prose.
wave_evidence.source: repro_native.py plus the reviewer independent probe

wave_evidence.claim: Every new check has a failing side.
wave_evidence.expected: Reverting each half reds the new tests.
wave_evidence.observed: Stamp reverted reds the origin-carrying tests; main() call site reverted reds the mismatch tests. Reproduced by the reviewer with its own edits.

wave_evidence.expected: Eleven unusable origin shapes take the pre-change path and none raises.
wave_evidence.observed: All eleven pass; test_worktree_precondition_wiring.py green and unweakened.

wave_evidence.claim: A dispatched crew runs in its spine worktree.
wave_evidence.expected: run_crew.launch_process sets cwd to the worktree.
wave_evidence.observed: Initially FALSE and wave-blocking. Human ruled option 1; run_crew now resolves every non-legacy crew cwd absolute and threads it through dispatch and resume. Default-dot red/green coverage and real subprocess evidence pass.
wave_evidence.source: g1b/g1c implementer results plus fresh g1c independent review

wave_evidence.claim: The in-process MCP door can drive an origin-stamped spine opened in another worktree without bypassing the engine guard.
wave_evidence.expected: The door stands in the bound spine worktree only for the engine call, restores ambient cwd, and the full open-drive-close lifecycle passes untouched.
wave_evidence.observed: Human-ruled option 2 implemented; chdir success/failure/SystemExit restoration, synchronous-loop pin, and untouched test_mcp_lifecycle all pass.

wave_evidence.claim: The engine-owned full-suite postcondition tests the same clean caller world as a normal suite invocation.
wave_evidence.expected: All tests pass under the integration gate.
wave_evidence.observed: The first frozen check inherited the MCP server's SPINE_FILE/SPINE_ENGINE/SPINE_SESSION and deterministically failed DC3InheritanceMechanismTests. Admiral ratified MCP retext-check clearing only those bindings for the pytest child; engine advance then passed without waiver.
wave_evidence.source: exact bound-env reproduction, Admiral ruling, execute.json amendment and terminal advance

discrepancies.signal: spine_open then claim in one session is impossible through the MCP door: spine_open creates a new worktree and stamps origin.worktree to it, and the in-process caller at mcp_spine_server.py:361 never chdirs, so it cannot already stand inside a directory that did not exist a moment earlier.
discrepancies.affects: The merge gate; the no-bypass ruling on the in-process caller.
discrepancies.evidence: tests/test_mcp_lifecycle.py FullStdioRoundTripTests fails and is the only failure. Reproduced by the Commander and the reviewer. Verb scope cannot fix it; the door supplying SPINE.parent toplevel measures equal to origin.worktree by construction.
discrepancies.reason: Every honest fix changed who sets cwd. Floated to the Admiral; the human ruled options 1 + 2 and both landed. Retained as wave-boundary evidence because it materially expanded the decomposition.

discrepancies.signal: The Commander launch-order reason that a crew cwd is its spine worktree is false.
discrepancies.affects: The premise the no-bypass ruling rested on.
discrepancies.reason: The ruling was settled on an unverified empirical claim and was reopened. Human-ruled option 1 now makes the premise true by construction.

discrepancies.signal: The origin stamp does not reach child checklists (review.json, IMPLEMENTER_PLAN.json), which is where crew subagents work.
discrepancies.evidence: The stamp lands only in init_work_area and spine_lifecycle.
discrepancies.reason: A scoped limit, not a defect in this change. Filed as tc8.

discrepancies.signal: instantiate_spine now writes escaped and reflowed JSON rather than the resolved text verbatim.
discrepancies.affects: The bytes of every instantiated spine.
discrepancies.evidence: 34 non-ASCII chars in COMMANDER_SPINE become escapes; condition dicts reflow. Parsed content, key order and rendered text unchanged; no consumer reads a spine as raw text.
discrepancies.reason: A recorded behaviour change, not a defect. Left unpatched so the merged change is the reviewed change. Filed as tc12.

discrepancies.evidence: Passed on re-run and three times in isolation; it snapshots the live .agent-work tree and a crew launcher was writing into it concurrently.
discrepancies.reason: Environmental, falsified as a finding against this change. Filed as tc11.

discrepancies.signal: The first caller repair promised an absolute crew cwd but default CLI root/worktree values of '.' remained relative; the original nine tests only supplied an already-absolute temporary root and could not see it.
discrepancies.affects: Human-ruled option 1 and the g1 independent-review exit.
discrepancies.evidence: Fresh Codex review BLOCK at rc8-absolute-cwd; direct crew_cwd('.', Path('.')) was relative. Bounded TDD rework added default-dot dispatch/resume coverage; fresh re-review APPROVE and 2981-test suite close it.
discrepancies.reason: A test-boundary hole, repaired within settled option 1 without a new policy choice.

discrepancies.signal: The frozen full-suite command was correct in a clean shell but false-red through MCP because engine command children inherit the door's SPINE_FILE/SPINE_ENGINE/SPINE_SESSION bindings, exactly what test_mcp_identity's clean-caller check refuses.
discrepancies.affects: The execute integration check mechanism under the epic's MCP-first engine path.
discrepancies.evidence: Clean shell: 2981 passed, 6 skipped. Exact MCP-bound environment: 1 failed, 2980 passed at DC3InheritanceMechanismTests. Admiral-ratified MCP retext-check clears only the three bindings for pytest; engine-owned advance passes without waiver.
discrepancies.reason: MCP adoption changed the environment contract of engine-owned command checks; the gate needed an authority-recorded check correction, not product rework or a waiver.
